title: Four-gate exclusive OR construction
statement: Given natural-number input labels $x,y$ and a label $L$, define an ordered list of four gates: an OR gate reading $x,y$; an AND gate reading $x,y$; a NOT gate reading $L+1$; and an AND gate reading $L,L+2$.
